name: MedStation
verdict: MedStation's biggest movement is a 918.98% spike in 7-day spend (totaling $104.96 over 28 days, led by the WARM-RETARGETING campaign at $48.77), likely driven by a ramp-up in Meta activity (210 clicks, $104.96 spend) after a period of minimal investment. Despite this surge, zero leads were generated across all channels, triggering the lead drought flag and signaling a critical disconnect between spend and conversion that needs immediate attention.

performance.verdict: $105 spent, 0 leads — stack not built yet, not a campaign problem.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: 0 leads from $104.96 spend across 28 days — CPL is undefined because the conversion path does not exist yet.
5 of 9 SOW milestones due 2026-07-31 are overdue 42+ days: pre-launch stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta CAPI, and landing pages/tracking — none show a completion event.
3 further milestones due 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-01 also unresolved: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, and nurture sequences — 10 days past due.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 4 straight days (Sep 7–10), down -85.71% 7d vs prior 7d — organic intent signal is now flat alongside paid.
GA4 sessions dropped to 5 on 2026-09-10 vs a 45-day average of ~109 — probable tracking outage or tag fire failure on that date; directional only.

suggestions.text: Halt all Meta spend (~$13.65/day) until landing pages, tracking, and GHL intake are confirmed live — spend with no conversion path is confirmed waste.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta is spending ~$13.65/day (total $104.96 over 28 days) with 0 leads generated. The pre-launch stack test, landing pages, and GHL migration are all overdue since 2026-07-31 with no completion event recorded. Pause active Meta spend immediately; resume only after one confirmed end-to-end test touch (ad click → tracked landing page → GHL opportunity created) is validated. Target stack test completion by 2026-09-18 before any budget goes back live.

suggestions.text: Investigate GA4 session collapse to 5 on Sep 10 — confirm whether tag/tracking failure, not a real traffic drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions recorded only 5 on 2026-09-10 against a 45-day average of ~109 — a near-total drop inconsistent with any spend or organic change. Check GTM container firing status, GA4 measurement ID, and any site deployments on that date. Success is confirmed when Sep 11–12 sessions return to the 100+ range or a root cause (e.g. tag removed in a deploy) is documented and fixed.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for 4 consecutive days (Sep 7–10) — re-check Sep 14 to confirm structural drop vs data delay.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on each of the last 4 days (Sep 7–10), a -85.71% drop vs the prior 7-day window. This could be a GBP data reporting lag or a real collapse in local organic intent. No action is warranted until the pattern holds through Sep 14. If actions remain at 0 by then, escalate GBP triage as a live milestone blocker — this milestone was already due 2026-07-31 per SOW.
